figures.caption: Commercial renovation permits are easier to manage when scope, existing conditions, drawings, services, approvals, and schedule assumptions are organized before submittal.

figures.alt: Commercial accessible restroom rough-in with fixture backing, plumbing connections, and clear floor area
figures.caption: Accessibility decisions affect room geometry, rough-in, fixtures, routes, clearances, finishes, and inspection. They should be integrated into the scope before work begins.

figures.alt: Historic wood double-hung window with localized sill repair and retained surrounding trim
figures.caption: Historic commercial work needs a condition-based approach to repair, materials, water management, approvals, and the character-defining elements of the existing building.
